notes.title: Update from 31.03.2021
notes.content:
- Minor bugs fixed.
The translation has been improved.
- Russian translation of the backpack.
- Russian translation of the pause menu.

notes.title: Update from 16.03.2021
notes.content:
- Minor bugs fixed.
- The Home level (Nursery) has become more comfortable. added the sound of fire by the fireplace and chimney, flowers, etc.
- Management is completely redone. Jams have been removed. Speed normalized.
- Disk space is almost halved.

notes.title: Update from 06.03.2021
notes.content:
- Bugs fixed.
- The Home (Nursery) map upgraded.
- Maps have been corrected.
- Reduced the number of objects to increase performance.
- Fixed display of sprites.
- A map with the location of open animals, insects and birds has been added to the Home (Nursery).
- Added territorial fences.
- Added commands to the Deer Home (Nursery). The ability to issue commands through the microphone will be added in the future. For example, tell the dog: sit down, voice, stand up. 
- The number of butterflies that need to be photographed has been reduced to 20.
Increased objects that can be found. 
- Checking the license now does not lead to being kicked out of the game, but redirects to the action scene.
- If the check failed the first time for any reason, for example, a bad Internet connection, you should restart Steam and try again.
